logline: Deep in the misty forest, Alexander confronts an injured Juliana and uncovers the wound inflicted by Lady Catherine, reacting with fury and protective concern upon learning that someone is systematically poisoning the Dowager Duchess with arsenic.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately following Juliana's ordeal at Ashburg Manor, where she escaped punishment after hiding the antidote and now encounters Alexander awaiting her on the woodland trail.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide tracking shot through a dense, sun-dappled forest as mist curls around towering tree trunks and tangled roots.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana walks hurriedly along the leaf-strewn forest path, clutching her dark hooded cloak tightly around her shoulders, breathing heavily.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium low-angle shot panning up as Alexander emerges from behind a moss-covered tree, blocking the trail.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grave, Alert)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana stopping abruptly, her expression guarded and weary.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Concerned, Suspicious)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Why are you walking like that?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana clutching the collar of her cloak with trembling fingers.

segments.label: JULIANA (Deflective, Breathless)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I am tired. That is all.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander steps forward and reaches out, his gloved hand firmly grasping her left shoulder. Juliana winces sharply and gasps in sudden pain.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot profile of Alexander grabbing Juliana's shoulder as she recoils.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Sharp, Alarmed)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You're hurt.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana gritting her teeth against the pain, shaking her head.

segments.label: JULIANA (Strained, Minimizing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: It is nothing.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander's gloved fingers pull back the torn fabric of her cloak and sleeve, revealing a raw, bloody welt slashing across her bare shoulder.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of the fresh riding-crop laceration cut across Juliana's shoulder.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander's scarred face darkening with volatile fury, his jaw tightening.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Seething, Dangerous)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Who did this?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana averting her eyes, her head bowed in quiet resignation.

segments.label: JULIANA (Subdued, Weary)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: It does not matter.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes burning with intense anger.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander steps directly into her space, firmly taking her hand in his.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Demanding, Stern)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Who?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, whispering the truth.

segments.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Apprehensive)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Lady Catherine.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander, his gaze piercing and hard.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Interrogating)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Where did you meet her?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana recounting the incident.

segments.label: JULIANA (Hedged)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I was in the wrong chamber. I was punished as a maid.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander, pressing her without hesitation.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Incredulous, Demanding)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: What were you doing there?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of Alexander leaning down toward her against the dim forest backdrop.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Fierce, Urgent)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Juliana... why were you inside Ashburg Manor?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana holding his gaze resolutely.

segments.label: JULIANA (Earnest)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I went there to help someone.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Blunt)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Who?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up profile of both of them locked in stillness.

segments.label: JULIANA (Solemn)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: The Dowager Duchess.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Alexander's face freezing in shock, his eyes widening as the revelation hits him.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Stunned, Disbelieving)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: The Dowager?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile tracking shot as Juliana begins walking slowly along the trail, Alexander following closely by her side.

segments.label: JULIANA (Urgent)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Prudence told me she was dying.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana turning toward him, recounting the scene in the bedchamber.

segments.label: JULIANA (Fervent)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: She was barely breathing when I found her. The doctor said she was simply growing old.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot as Juliana stops and looks up into Alexander's grim expression.

segments.label: JULIANA (Chilling, Definite)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: But it wasn't age.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander staring down at her, waiting for the dark truth.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grim, Low)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: What did you find?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Juliana's trembling lips.

segments.label: JULIANA (Hushed, Horrified)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Poison.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Slightly wider close-up as Juliana's eyes well with distress.

segments.label: JULIANA (Sober)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Arsenic.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander's hand drops to his side and clenches into a white-knuckled fist, the thick scar across his hand tightening with intense restraint.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander's fist clenching tightly in fury.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana, her voice filled with mounting dread.

segments.label: JULIANA (Pained, Troubled)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Someone has been giving it to her again and again. Small amounts. Enough to make her weaker without killing her quickly.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander processing the sinister calculation behind the poisoning.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot as Juliana looks up at him with quiet hope.

segments.label: JULIANA (Sincere, Earnest)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I made her medicine. She was still barely conscious, but her breathing became easier.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander's startled gaze.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Incredulous)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You treated her?

segments.label: JULIANA (Firm)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Yes.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up profile of the two facing each other.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Tense)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Alone?

segments.label: JULIANA (Soft)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: With Prudence.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander, his brow furrowed with deep protective worry.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Anxious)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Will you be going there again?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes filled with resolute purpose.

segments.label: JULIANA (Determined)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I have to.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana places her gentle hand against Alexander's broad chest, trying to soothe his rising anger.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot of Juliana leaning in, her hand resting over Alexander's coat.

segments.label: JULIANA (Pleading, Defiant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: She is still sick. I cannot leave her there.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander takes both of her hands into his own, gripping them tightly.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of Alexander holding Juliana's hands in the dusky woods.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his darkened face with questioning concern.

segments.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Perplexed)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Alexander... why are you so angry?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander speaking through clenched teeth, barely containing his protective fury.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Fierce, Reproachful)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Because you were standing inside a house where someone is poisoning a woman... and you never told me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana looking down sheepishly before raising her eyes.

segments.label: JULIANA (Vulnerable)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I knew you would worry.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Alexander, his voice trembling with terrified passion.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Furious, Tormented)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Worry? They struck you. They could have killed you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot as Juliana looks up into his eyes, holding firm.

segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Soothing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: But they didn't.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of their clasped hands, panning up to Alexander's tormented gaze.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grim, Fearful)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: This time.

segments.label: JULIANA (Sincere, Steadfast)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I am being careful.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot as Juliana looks at him earnestly.

segments.label: JULIANA (Resolute)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I cannot abandon her.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander closes his eyes for a brief, agonizing second, exhaling deeply as he yields to her unshakeable conviction.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander opening his piercing eyes, resignation and steadfast devotion washing over his features.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Resigned, Steely)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Then tell me everything.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as Alexander holds her gaze in the twilight shadows.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Uncompromising)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Everything you saw.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander turns, falling into step beside Juliana. Together, side by side, they begin their quiet walk down the darkening forest path into the twilight.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide tracking shot from behind Alexander and Juliana as their silhouettes disappear into the shadowy, mist-veiled forest as emotional strings swell to a resolving chord.
